sources.games: 637 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats, support position: under 2.5 last hits a minute), win 52.9%. Thin: the Spirit Vessel rule has 94 healing games but only ~12 with the item. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py witch_doctor.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-11-07 (support wave): the build follows the STRATZ high-rank order where it and the league games disagree; Eul's Scepter answers Phantom Strike and Charge of Darkness (Jakiro, Rubick, Skywrath Mage, Tusk); Rod of Atos against escapes (a root stops walking and blink escapes); Ghost Scepter against two physical carries stays on thin samples; the skill builds and talents are the most common ones.

rules.name: Spirit Vessel
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Spirit Vessel (2725 gold): Soul Release on an enemy cuts health restoration by 70%, drains 4% of current health a second and deals 25 damage a second for 8 s, 750 cast range, 10 s cooldown. Not in the usual build; against Lifestealer, Oracle, Huskar, Necrophos or Alchemist high-rank Witch Doctors buy it in 13% of 94 games (3% otherwise), won 67% against 50%; Urn of Shadows, its first step, 27% against 12%.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 98% (2), magic_wand 90% (9), ring_of_basilius 94% (10), arcane_boots 93% (12), glimmer_cape 51% (22), aghanims_shard 61% (25), blink 43% (28), staff_of_wizardry 39% (29), ghost 26% (30), point_booster 21% (32), ogre_axe 21% (34), vitality_booster 20% (34). Reviewed: dropped Ring of Basilius, Staff of Wizardry, Point Booster, Ogre Axe and Vitality Booster (parts). STRATZ pos5 (10364 games): Glimmer Cape 22 (64%), Blink Dagger 23 (69%), Aghanim's Scepter 35 (38%) -> Blink earlier and the Scepter added; the league games have Glimmer 21.5, Shard 25, Blink 28 and Ghost 30 (26%). Ordered by the STRATZ high-rank pos5 minute where STRATZ lists the item (10364 games), else the league minute (the player review of 2026-11-07: the STRATZ order where the two disagree).
